# hodrecomp - Castlevania: Harmony of Despair (Xbox 360) static recompilation
#
# SDK boilerplate lives in generated/rexglue.cmake (regenerated by rexglue).

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(hodrecomp VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

include(CTest)

# rexglue.cmake only links generated sources that exist when it is included.
# On the first configure after extracting a dump, run codegen right away so a
# single build produces the game instead of needing a second configure.
# (Source-tree SDK builds via REXSDK_DIR have no rexglue binary yet; they keep
# the stock flow: build the hodrecomp_codegen target, then reconfigure.)
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/modules/default.xex"
   AND NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/default/sources.cmake"
   AND NOT REXSDK_DIR)
    find_package(rexglue CONFIG QUIET)
    if(TARGET rex::rexglue)
        get_target_property(HODRECOMP_REXGLUE_EXE rex::rexglue LOCATION)
        message(STATUS "hodrecomp: running initial codegen with ${HODRECOMP_REXGLUE_EXE}")
        execute_process(
            COMMAND "${HODRECOMP_REXGLUE_EXE}" codegen
                    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/hodrecomp_manifest.toml"
            WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
            RESULT_VARIABLE HODRECOMP_CODEGEN_RESULT)
        if(NOT HODRECOMP_CODEGEN_RESULT EQUAL 0)
            message(WARNING
                "hodrecomp: initial codegen failed (${HODRECOMP_CODEGEN_RESULT}). "
                "Run 'rexglue codegen --force hodrecomp_manifest.toml' to see the errors "
                "(docs/BRINGUP.md), then reconfigure.")
        endif()
    endif()
endif()

include(generated/rexglue.cmake)

# Installer core: shared by the first-run wizard and hodtool.
add_library(hodinstall STATIC
    src/install/installer.cpp
    src/install/sha256.cpp
)
target_include_directories(hodinstall PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src)
target_link_libraries(hodinstall PUBLIC rex::runtime)
rexglue_apply_target_settings(hodinstall)

# Windows has no rpath: every executable needs the SDK's DLLs beside it.
# TARGET_RUNTIME_DLLS covers rexruntime and its public dependencies, but not
# FidelityFX, which rexruntime links privately (the SDK's own helper copies
# that only for in-tree SDK builds, under unprefixed target names).
function(hodrecomp_stage_windows_dlls target_name)
    if(NOT WIN32)
        return()
    endif()
    add_custom_command(TARGET ${target_name} POST_BUILD
        COMMAND "$<$<BOOL:$<TARGET_RUNTIME_DLLS:${target_name}>>:${CMAKE_COMMAND};-E;copy_if_different;$<TARGET_RUNTIME_DLLS:${target_name}>;$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target_name}>>"
        COMMAND_EXPAND_LISTS
        VERBATIM)
    foreach(fidelityfx rex::amd_fidelityfx_dx12 rex::amd_fidelityfx_vk)
        if(TARGET ${fidelityfx})
            add_custom_command(TARGET ${target_name} POST_BUILD
                COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
                    $<TARGET_FILE:${fidelityfx}> $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target_name}>
                VERBATIM)
        endif()
    endforeach()
endfunction()

option(HODRECOMP_BUILD_TOOLS "Build hodtool (dump extraction and analysis helpers)" ON)
if(HODRECOMP_BUILD_TOOLS)
    add_subdirectory(tools/hodtool)
endif()

# The game itself can only be generated from the user's own default.xex and
# DLLs, which 'hodtool stage-modules' collects into modules/. Re-run configure
# whenever that folder changes so staging picks the game target up on the
# next build.
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/modules")

if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/modules/default.xex")
    set(HODRECOMP_SOURCES
        src/main.cpp
        src/locale.cpp
        src/ui/fonts.cpp
        src/ui/installer_wizard.cpp
        src/cheats.cpp
        src/settings.cpp
        src/ui/achievements_screen.cpp
        src/ui/menu_common.cpp
        src/ui/options_menu.cpp
    )

    if(WIN32)
        # Icon and version info for Explorer. CMake enables the resource
        # compiler (rc.exe from the VS environment) for clang on Windows.
        set(HODRECOMP_ICON "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/icon/hodrecomp.ico")
        configure_file(src/win/hodrecomp.rc.in "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/hodrecomp.rc" @ONLY)
        list(APPEND HODRECOMP_SOURCES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/hodrecomp.rc")
        add_executable(hodrecomp WIN32 ${HODRECOMP_SOURCES})
    else()
        add_executable(hodrecomp ${HODRECOMP_SOURCES})
    endif()

    # xenos is the Xenos GPU emulation plugin (Vulkan on Linux, D3D12 on
    # Windows); it is loaded at runtime and staged next to the executable.
    rexglue_setup_target(hodrecomp GPU_PLUGINS xenos)
    target_link_libraries(hodrecomp PRIVATE hodinstall)
    hodrecomp_stage_windows_dlls(hodrecomp)

    # Guest DLLs that share an address range with ones in the main manifest
    # are recompiled in extra codegen passes (passes/pass<N>, written by
    # 'hodtool stage-modules').
    include(cmake/codegen_passes.cmake)
    hodrecomp_add_codegen_passes()
    # stage-modules rewrites the manifest whenever the module set changes;
    # reconfigure then so new or removed passes are picked up.
    set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/hodrecomp_manifest.toml")

    # Every recompiled guest DLL, from the main manifest and the passes.
    get_property(HODRECOMP_MODULE_TARGETS GLOBAL PROPERTY HODRECOMP_MODULE_TARGETS)
    get_property(HODRECOMP_ROOT_TARGETS DIRECTORY PROPERTY BUILDSYSTEM_TARGETS)
    foreach(HODRECOMP_TARGET IN LISTS HODRECOMP_ROOT_TARGETS)
        get_target_property(HODRECOMP_TARGET_TYPE ${HODRECOMP_TARGET} TYPE)
        if(HODRECOMP_TARGET_TYPE STREQUAL "SHARED_LIBRARY" AND HODRECOMP_TARGET MATCHES "^hodrecomp_")
            list(APPEND HODRECOMP_MODULE_TARGETS ${HODRECOMP_TARGET})
        endif()
    endforeach()
    # The runtime loads each one by its bare target name (hodrecomp_dllAlucard).
    # LoadLibrary adds ".dll" and searches the executable's folder, but dlopen
    # looks for exactly that name (next to librexruntime, whose RUNPATH is
    # $ORIGIN), so elsewhere build them without the lib prefix and suffix.
    if(NOT WIN32 AND HODRECOMP_MODULE_TARGETS)
        set_target_properties(${HODRECOMP_MODULE_TARGETS} PROPERTIES PREFIX "" SUFFIX "")
    endif()
    # Lets developer builds find game/ without --game_data_root. Not in
    # Release: a player's build must not look in the build machine's folders.
    target_compile_definitions(hodrecomp PRIVATE
        $<$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Release>>:HODRECOMP_SOURCE_GAME_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/game">)

    # UI fonts (SIL OFL, see assets/fonts) are loaded from fonts/ beside the exe.
    add_custom_command(TARGET hodrecomp POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/fonts $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:hodrecomp>/fonts
        VERBATIM)

    # The SDK stages its shared runtime libraries next to the executable on
    # Windows and macOS only; the Linux binary uses a bare $ORIGIN rpath, so
    # do the same staging here.
    if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
        foreach(HODRECOMP_RUNTIME_LIB rex::runtime)
            if(TARGET ${HODRECOMP_RUNTIME_LIB})
                add_custom_command(TARGET hodrecomp POST_BUILD
                    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
                        $<TARGET_FILE:${HODRECOMP_RUNTIME_LIB}>
                        $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:hodrecomp>
                    VERBATIM)
            endif()
        endforeach()
        # Under its soname (libSDL3.so.0), the name the binaries look up.
        if(TARGET SDL3::SDL3-shared)
            add_custom_command(TARGET hodrecomp POST_BUILD
                COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
                    $<TARGET_SONAME_FILE:SDL3::SDL3-shared>
                    $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:hodrecomp>
                VERBATIM)
        endif()
    endif()

    # Packaging: 'cmake --install <build dir> --prefix <folder>' lays out a
    # self-contained game folder: the executable, every shared library the
    # build staged next to it (SDK runtime, GPU plugin, recompiled guest DLLs),
    # fonts, hodtool, and a short readme. Game data is not part of it; the
    # first-run installer (or scripts/build_windows.ps1) puts that in game/.
    install(TARGETS hodrecomp RUNTIME DESTINATION .)
    if(TARGET hodtool)
        install(TARGETS hodtool RUNTIME DESTINATION .)
    endif()
    install(CODE "
        file(GLOB _hodrecomp_libs
            \"$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:hodrecomp>/*${CMAKE_SHARED_LIBRARY_SUFFIX}\"
            \"$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:hodrecomp>/*${CMAKE_SHARED_LIBRARY_SUFFIX}.*\")
        # The SDK stages its profiler library (Tracy) too; Release builds
        # don't use it, so it isn't shipped (and an old copy is removed).
        list(FILTER _hodrecomp_libs EXCLUDE REGEX \"[Tt]racy\")
        file(INSTALL \${_hodrecomp_libs} DESTINATION \"\${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}\")
        file(GLOB _hodrecomp_stale \"\${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/*[Tt]racy*\")
        if(_hodrecomp_stale)
            file(REMOVE \${_hodrecomp_stale})
        endif()
    ")
    foreach(HODRECOMP_TARGET IN LISTS HODRECOMP_MODULE_TARGETS)
        install(FILES $<TARGET_FILE:${HODRECOMP_TARGET}> DESTINATION .)
    endforeach()
    install(DIRECTORY assets/fonts/ DESTINATION fonts)
    install(FILES assets/package/README.txt docs/CONTROLS.md DESTINATION .)
    option(HODRECOMP_PORTABLE
        "Package with portable.txt: saves, DLC and caches stay in the install folder" ON)
    if(HODRECOMP_PORTABLE)
        install(FILES assets/package/portable.txt DESTINATION .)
    endif()
else()
    message(STATUS
        "hodrecomp: modules/default.xex not found, building tools only. Install "
        "your own game with hodtool, then run 'hodtool stage-modules' "
        "(see docs/GETTING_STARTED.md).")
endif()
